MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 8, 2026
  255 N. MARINA DRIVE
  SEAL BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Gordana Kajer, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Jo Murray, Vice Chair  Timothy Ehrlich, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  tamalyn.sayre@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56197  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, August 13, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56368  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the 50th anniversary of the
  California Coastal Act of 1976.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56203  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Disaster Preparedness and
  Emergency Communications on Citywide preparations for El Niño.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56198  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56199  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive and Finance Committee status
  reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56202  Recommendation to review and consider the dissolution of Marine Advisory
  Commission (MAC) subcommittees; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve
  MAC subcommittees.

  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 8, 2026
  255 N. MARINA DRIVE
  SEAL BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
